ROUTE: Lapwing-235B
REASON: My choice came down to task-fit. The query is an open-ended, explanatory request ("explain the differences between science and technology")—essentially generative work rather than strict extraction or transformation. Lapwing-235B reports a strong preference for open-ended generative work (win-rate 71 vs. Avocet's lower transactional preference) and scores marginally higher on Creative Generation (81.2 vs 78.8). Since capability is otherwise comparable across the fleet and cost/latency are identical, routing to the model that both prefers and slightly excels at this task type was the sensible call. There was no harm-adjacent or adversarial element that would have argued against Lapwing.
